paragraphs.text: translated by
1. Be, like thyself, O Indra, strong for our delight: here lauded, aid us, Maghavan, drinker of the juice.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र दृह्य मघवन्त्वावदिद्भुज इह स्तुतः सुतपा बोधि नो वृधे ।
paragraphs.translit: indra dṛhya maghavantvāvadidbhuja iha stutaḥ sutapā bodhi no vṛdhe |

paragraphs.text: Savitar with the Gods protect us: hear ye Twain. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: देवेभिर्नः सविता प्रावतु श्रुतमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: devebhirnaḥ savitā prāvatu śrutamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 2. Bring swift, for offering, the snare that suits the time, to the pure-drinker Vayu, roaring as he goes,
paragraphs.original: भराय सु भरत भागमृत्वियं प्र वायवे शुचिपे क्रन्ददिष्टये ।
paragraphs.translit: bharāya su bharata bhāgamṛtviyaṃ pra vāyave śucipe krandadiṣṭaye |

paragraphs.text: To him who hath approached the draught of shining milk. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: गौरस्य यः पयसः पीतिमानश आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: gaurasya yaḥ payasaḥ pītimānaśa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 3. May Savitar the God send us full life, to each who sacrifices, lives aright and pours the juice
paragraphs.original: आ नो देवः सविता साविषद्वय ऋजूयते यजमानाय सुन्वते ।
paragraphs.translit: ā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣadvaya ṛjūyate yajamānāya sunvate |

paragraphs.text: That we with simple hearts may wait upon the Gods. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: यथा देवान्प्रतिभूषेम पाकवदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: yathā devānpratibhūṣema pākavadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 4. May Indra evermore be gracious unto us, and may King Soma meditate our happiness,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो अस्मे सुमना अस्तु विश्वहा राजा सोमः सुवितस्याध्येतु नः ।
paragraphs.translit: indro asme sumanā astu viśvahā rājā somaḥ suvitasyādhyetu naḥ |

paragraphs.text: Even as men secure the comfort of a friend. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: यथायथा मित्रधितानि संदधुरा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: yathāyathā mitradhitāni saṃdadhurā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 5. Indra hath given the body with its song and strength: Brhaspati, thou art the lengthener of life.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्र उक्थेन शवसा परुर्दधे बृहस्पते प्रतरीतास्यायुषः ।
paragraphs.translit: indra ukthena śavasā parurdadhe bṛhaspate pratarītāsyāyuṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: The sacrifice is Manu, Providence, our Sire. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: यज्ञो मनुः प्रमतिर्नः पिता हि कमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: yajño manuḥ pramatirnaḥ pitā hi kamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 6. Indra possesseth might celestial nobly formed: the singer in the hotise is Agni, prudent Sage.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रस्य नु सुकृतं दैव्यं सहोऽग्निर्गृहे जरिता मेधिरः कविः ।
paragraphs.translit: indrasya nu sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho'gnirgṛhe jaritā medhiraḥ kaviḥ |

paragraphs.text: lie is the sacrifice in synod, fair, most near. We ask for freedom and complete felicity,
paragraphs.original: यज्ञश्च भूद्विदथे चारुरन्तम आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: yajñaśca bhūdvidathe cārurantama ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 7. Not often have we sinned against you secretly, nor, Vasus, have we openly provoked the Gods.
paragraphs.original: न वो गुहा चकृम भूरि दुष्कृतं नाविष्ट्यं वसवो देवहेळनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: na vo guhā cakṛma bhūri duṣkṛtaṃ nāviṣṭyaṃ vasavo devaheḷanam |

paragraphs.text: Not one of its, ye Gods, hath worn an alien shape. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: माकिर्नो देवा अनृतस्य वर्पस आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: mākirno devā anṛtasya varpasa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 8. May Savitar remove from us our malady, and may the Mountains keep it far away from where
paragraphs.original: अपामीवां सविता साविषन्न्यग्वरीय इदप सेधन्त्वद्रयः ।
paragraphs.translit: apāmīvāṃ savitā sāviṣannyagvarīya idapa sedhantvadrayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: The press-stone as it sheds the meath rings loudly forth. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 9. Ye Vasus, let the stone, the presser stand erect: avert all enmities and keep them far remote.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा वसवोऽस्तु सोतरि विश्वा द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत ।
paragraphs.translit: ūrdhvo grāvā vasavo'stu sotari viśvā dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota |

paragraphs.text: Our guard to be adored is Savitar this God. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: स नो देवः सविता पायुरीड्य आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: sa no devaḥ savitā pāyurīḍya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 10. Eat strength and fatness in the pasture, kine, who are balmed at the reservoir and at the seat of Law.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्जं गावो यवसे पीवो अत्तन ऋतस्य याः सदने कोशे अङ्ग्ध्वे ।
paragraphs.translit: ūrjaṃ gāvo yavase pīvo attana ṛtasya yāḥ sadane kośe aṅgdhve |

paragraphs.text: So let your body be our body's medicine. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: तनूरेव तन्वो अस्तु भेषजमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: tanūreva tanvo astu bheṣajamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 11. The singer fills the spirit: all mens, love hath he. Indra takes kindly care of those who pour the juice.
paragraphs.original: क्रतुप्रावा जरिता शश्वतामव इन्द्र इद्भद्रा प्रमतिः सुतावताम् ।
paragraphs.translit: kratuprāvā jaritā śaśvatāmava indra idbhadrā pramatiḥ sutāvatām |

paragraphs.text: For his libation is the heavenly udder full. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.
paragraphs.original: पूर्णमूधर्दिव्यं यस्य सिक्तय आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: pūrṇamūdhardivyaṃ yasya siktaya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 12. Wondrous thy spirit-filling light, triumphant; thy hosts save from decay and are resistless.
paragraphs.original: चित्रस्ते भानुः क्रतुप्रा अभिष्टिः सन्ति स्पृधो जरणिप्रा अधृष्टाः ।
paragraphs.translit: citraste bhānuḥ kratuprā abhiṣṭiḥ santi spṛdho jaraṇiprā adhṛṣṭāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The pious votary by straightest pathway speeds to possess the best of all the cattle.
paragraphs.original: रजिष्ठया रज्या पश्व आ गोस्तूतूर्षति पर्यग्रं दुवस्युः
paragraphs.translit: rajiṣṭhayā rajyā paśva ā gostūtūrṣati paryagraṃ duvasyuḥ
